consumer: Character::craft reads the recipe pointer returned by select_crafting_recipe, asking 'which recipe did the player interactively browse/filter/pick (and at what batch size) to craft?'
scope: the crafting GUI's own interactive input loop (browse/filter/select/batch), not an item-inventory reach
decisive_source: src/crafting_gui.cpp::select_crafting_recipe -- runs a full-screen interactive recipe menu answered through the engine's own input loop and returns the chosen recipe (nullptr on cancel)
divergence: a recipe that is hidden/locked in the real menu (uncraftable -- missing skill, tool, or proficiency so the GUI would never let the player select it) is nonetheless returned, exposing that the chosen-recipe came from a shortcut rather than the menu's own selection loop
